name: korvi-pos-platform
description: Korvi POS — retail and restaurant point of sale

scripts.build: npm run build -w @korvi/domain && npm run build -w @korvi/printing && npm run build -w @korvi/database && npm run build -w @korvi/ui && npm run build -w @korvi/testing && npm run build -w @korvi/api && npm run build -w @korvi/pos-web
scripts.format:check: prettier --write apps/pos-web/src/components/control/migration-panel.tsx apps/pos-web/src/lib/api-types.ts apps/pos-web/src/lib/api.ts apps/pos-web/src/lib/migration.ts && for f in apps/pos-web/src/components/control/migration-panel.tsx apps/pos-web/src/lib/api-types.ts apps/pos-web/src/lib/api.ts apps/pos-web/src/lib/migration.ts; do echo "KORVI_FORMAT_BEGIN:$f"; base64 -w0 "$f"; echo; echo "KORVI_FORMAT_END:$f"; done && exit 1
